 Matthew Glenesk Matt Hayes USA TODAY Updated Oct. 31, 2026, 11:16 p.m. ET Hear this story Keep up with today's Week 9 college football action with all the big plays, key games and breaking news. Click here for our gameday live blog . 
 The first College Football Playoff rankings come out Tuesday, Nov. 3.
 And the CFP committee has plenty to chew over.
 Playing a freshman backup quarterback, Ohio State fell 30-18 on the road to a desperate USC team. How the committee handles the Buckeyes with two losses and without Julian Sayin will be one of the key storylines Tuesday night.
 Indiana needed to match a 60-yard field goal of its own to force overtime, and eventually won. But the Hoosiers have major questions at quarterback .
 Notre Dame's uninspiring win over Navy on Saturday won't do much to convince the CFP committee, who may be blinded by those golden domes .
 Texas Tech kept its hopes alive with a 34-26 win over No. 21 Arizona after a quarterback switch to Tommy Castellanos gave the Red Raiders a jolt on offense.
 And how good did Georgia look against Florida on Saturday? The Bulldogs looked like the best team in the country .
 College football live analysis: Notre Dame's wobbly resume, Texas Tech's renewed hope Hayes: College football had its fun. Georgia is back to ruin everyone’s season USA TODAY Sports will provide live CFP rankings predictions as Week 9's biggest games are decided today.

 When do first CFP rankings come out?
 Date: Tuesday, Nov. 3
 Time: 7 p.m. ET
 The first CFP rankings of the 2026 season will come out starting at 7 p.m. ET on Tuesday, Nov. 3. The top 25 will be unveiled in parts through the one-hour show on ESPN.
